lines.t: Yeah, I see the highlight real, I see the frame, I see the fake
I see you playing the part until your heart is about to break
You're out there living the dream or just living a lie
Searching for likes while the light in your eye starts to die
You're thriving in high school, yeah, you're loving the sport
But the court is a cage and your breath is getting short
When you're chasing a trophy, chasing a vibe, chasing a ghost
But what's the point of the win if you're the one losing the most?
Is the locker room loud enough to drown out the silence?
Or is the war in your head reaching a level of violence?
Shut them all out, keep the mask on tight
Tell them you're fine while you're losing the fight
I see you!
And what about the family, what about the new crew?
Do they love the image or do they actually know you?
They hold you in the dark, do they pray through the night
Or do they only want the heat when you're standing in light
You trade in the sanctuary for a pagan parade
Building a house out of cards, just to sit in the shade
I know the look in your eyes, I know the weight of the mass
I know the questions you're way too terrified to ask
Is it everything you hoped, is it really that sweet
Or are you just walking on glass with blood on your feet
Answer the question
Clock is ticking, pixels flickering, are you losing the soul
Trying to patch up the puncture, are you losing control
You're building a kingdom on a handful of sand
How's it feel to have the world and nothing in your hand?
Are you happy, or are you just hiding away?
Is the smile just a price that you're willing to pay?
Is it empty?
Does it leave you cold in the night, chasing the shadow
and calling it light?
I know the manner, I know the peace.
I'm waiting for the moment you find your release.
Look, don't get it twisted, I ain't throwing no stones
I'm just hearing the rattle of the drop, brittle bones
You're addicted to the ego, intoxicated by the fame
But the enemy is laughing while he's carving your name
You think you're the pilot, you're just a passion now
Selling the crown for a seat in the back of the crowd
Trade the living water for a cup full of salt
And when it all falls down, tell me who's at fault
You running from the altar to a stage made of tin
I'm screaming rent in while you're settling in
The father is calling, the debt has been paid
So why are you so sleeping in the grave you made?
Hey, is it enough?
Is it enough?
The world is a lie, the road is too rough
You can fake the holiday, you can fake the wind
But you can't fit the spirit that's calling from within
I see the crack in the stone, I see the heart on the shelf
You're a stranger to the father, you're a ghost to yourself
I'm standing in the gap, I'm praying for the break
For every single move and every rep that you take
Are you happy?
Or are you just hiding away?
Is this my just a price that you're willing to pay?
Is it empty?
Does it leave you cold in the night?
Chasing a shadow, I'm calling it light
I know the manner, I know the peace
I'm waiting for the moment you find your relief
Are you happy?
Or are you just hiding away?
Is this smile just a price that you're willing to pay?
Is it empty?
Does it leave you cold in the night?
Chasing a shadow and calling it love
Are you happy?
Are you happy?
Are you real?
Are you real?
I know the answer, I see the mask
But I'm staying, I'm waiting
